research: Line: slate Ravens -4.5; archive open -2.5, close -3.5. Predictem (Joe Jensen) says it opened -3 and rose to -4.5 at most books (a few -4); Covers lists -4.5 on game day. Total 48.5 open to 39.5 close. Slate and close differ by 1. Spread-specific; close treated as fair.

[angle] Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is on IR with a right thumb injury, expected out 6-9 weeks; backup Tyler Huntley is also on IR (toe). Jacoby Brissett, traded in and described as Baltimore's fourth QB of the season, starts and called it a 'crash course' with the offense (Predictem; Covers, Josh Inglis, Nov 16 2026 5:12 PM ET). Known before the close; priced. Helps LAC on scoring ability.

Ravens are 4-5 and 1-3 at home on a four-game losing streak, scoring 10, 13, 10 and 10; they lost 33-10 to Jacksonville on TNF when rookie Joe Fagnano threw for 60 yards and 2 INTs (Predictem). A favorite that can't score; helps LAC.

Chargers are 0-8, 0-7-1 ATS, and haven't lost a game by fewer than six points; most recently 44-22 to Houston (Covers; Predictem). Repeated margin pattern; helps BAL -4.5 (ATS records themselves are priced).

Chargers' offense ranks last in EPA per play and success rate, averages 15.1 ppg, has 19 turnovers (-7 margin), and is second-last in red-zone trips per game with the 4th-worst red-zone TD rate (Predictem; Covers). Helps BAL.

[angle] Justin Herbert has a left middle finger injury (X-rays negative, Harbaugh says he 'should be good to go') and has been sacked 31 times in eight games, 8 times vs Houston; the line allows 3.9 sacks per game (2nd-most) and the Chargers 'could be changing starters on the O-line' (Predictem; Covers). Helps BAL.
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (back spasms) didn't practice Thursday and missed last week (Covers; Predictem). Helps BAL.
[angle] Rest and travel: Baltimore last played Thursday Nov 5, about 11 days to prepare; the Chargers fly cross-country for a night kickoff on normal rest (Predictem). Known; priced. Mild BAL.
Chargers' defense ranks 29th in EPA per rush since Week 3 (Covers), facing Derrick Henry, whom Covers projects at about 94 yards on 20+ carries. Helps BAL.
Chargers are 6-2 to the Under and have led for just 66 minutes all season (Covers). Low-scoring games make a 4.5 margin harder to clear; mixed.
Weather: 43F at kickoff, 6.3 mph winds, little chance of rain (Covers). Neutral.
Previews: Predictem takes Ravens -4.5 (projects 23-16) and flags Herbert's arm and a backdoor cover as risks; Covers' Inglis plays the Under 38.5 and Henry overs. Priced; neutral.
games.reasoning: No read. The Chargers' season-long pattern (0-8, no loss by under 6, last in EPA, sacked constantly) points to Baltimore, but Baltimore is on its fourth QB and has scored 10-13 points in four straight. The close of 3.5 sits about 1 below the slate. A projection of about 5 is within 2 of the 4.5. The most interesting angle is a favorite with two QBs on IR laying points in a 39.5-total game. A Herbert setback in warmups would have made Baltimore a lean.
